## Summary
Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.
The code change and its updated default test are consistent, but the README still says the default timeout is 30 seconds, so it needs updating to match the new 60-second default.

## Changes
This pull request raises `DEFAULT_TIMEOUT` in `app/cli.py` from 30 to 60 and updates `test_defaults` to expect 60. It also adds a one-line `review.txt` at the repository root.

## Important
- app/cli.py:3 — comments — Update README to state the 60-second default — After this change, a user who omits `--timeout` gets a 60-second timeout, but `README.md:3` still reads "Requests time out after 30 seconds unless you pass `--timeout SECONDS`." — Users who rely on the README expect requests to fail at 30 seconds and get the wrong value for the default. — Fix: Change `README.md:3` to say 60 seconds.
